text:
Priya (CS): hey infra — customers reporting spike in 5xxs and timeouts on hosted API since ~09:23 UTC. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate. Sample ticket + req ids: https://support.company/t/3421 req=abc123 req=def456
Alex (eng-sre): on it. tagging oncall. any repro steps or logs? :rotating_light:
Priya (CS): customers see upstream 502/504 and partial failures. Latency also up ~2x. I attached sample request/response in the ticket.
Jamal (eng-runtime): pulling logs now — I can see a config flip at 2026-03-17T09:22:11Z (cfg-2026-03-17-09). A canary flag `enable_kv_prefetch=false` was pushed to 10% via selector. Looks like the selector mistakenly targeted a route weight label.
Rachel (oncall): checking telemetry dashboards — /v1/generate error rate jumped at 09:23:30 UTC. Backend shard runtime-2 returning upstream read timeout. Region eu-west-1 shows biggest spike.
Jamal (eng-runtime): quick repro (from our staging curl with same headers):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# response: HTTP/1.1 502
# body: {"error":"upstream read timeout","request_id":"abc123"}
```
Priya (CS): impact: ~15% of production requests hit 5xx, several high-usage customers reported billing anomalies (charges for failed attempts). I flagged billing ops.
Alex (eng-sre): plan: rollback the canary flag to previous state + temporarily lower canary traffic. Jamal can you run the rollback? Also toggle shedder to preserve capacity if we see more timeouts.
Jamal (eng-runtime): running revert now:
`infractl config rollback cfg-2026-03-17-09 --scope=canary --reason="5xx spike"`
deploy-bot: rollback job started: job_id=7890 — monitoring logs and rollout status
Rachel (oncall): patch applied to canary selector, reducing affected hosts. I'm also flipping shedder throttle to 80% for route /v1/generate.
Jamal (eng-runtime): observed 5xx rate start falling at 09:26:10 UTC after rollback propagation. Will keep watching for a full return to baseline.
Alex (eng-sre): can you capture all traces for request ids abc123/def456 and any new ones for RCA? Also add `cfg-2026-03-17-09` to the incident artifact list.
Priya (CS): will notify customers that we rolled back a canary config and are investigating. Drafting message now.
deploy-bot: rollback job completed: job_id=7890 status=success duration=2m34s
Jamal (eng-runtime): rollback confirmed. Error rate back to baseline by 09:30 UTC in eu-west-1. Collecting traces and diffs between cfg-2026-03-17-09 and previous config. Early root cause: selector scope bug caused flag to apply to route-weight label vs internal prefetch-slice, resulting in unintended routing to kernelpath v2 on a subset of hosts. That kernelpath currently has a timeout pathology under mid-sequence load.
Rachel (oncall): next steps: block re-release of cfg-2026-03-17-09, add guard in rollout pipeline to validate selector expressions, run canary in isolated slice only. I'll open a JIRA for rollout guard rails.
Alex (eng-sre): +1. Add preflight canary sanity check: synthetic traffic with KV cache enabled/disabled and assert error < 0.5% before scaling to >1%.
Priya (CS): thanks team — I'll update the affected customers and close the escalation once we have RCA writeup.
Jamal (eng-runtime): saving collected logs/traces to S3: s3://redwood-incident-archives/1748001111/
Alex (eng-sre): postmortem required. Tagging: postmortem, billing-impact, canary-selector-bug.
Priya (CS): sending customer note now. will follow up when RCA is ready. :thumbsup:
Rachel (oncall): incident resolved for now. monitoring alerts suppressed until we verify long-term fix.
